sql: with t as (select distinct strategy, market_ticker from live_orders where strategy in ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Fmmsell10','Jmmsell10') and action='buy'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, coalesce(quantity_fp, quantity) q, market_exposure, captured_at from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from t) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select t.strategy, t.market_ticker, p.q, p.market_exposure, to_char(p.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') snap from t join p using (market_ticker) where abs(p.q) > 0.01 order by t.strategy, t.market_ticker
